fail.quote: Add a performance budget to CI, using Lighthouse CI or the equivalent, with thresholds for LCP, total JS bytes, and image bytes on the home page, so regressions fail the build.
fail.reason: The prompt expands website optimization into an ongoing build-blocking CI workflow without making that added scope conditional on owner approval. Its approval list gates paid services, production actions, tags, and conversion experiments, but not this workflow change.
